name: kudonovel
description: A novel-writing tool: draft your story beat by beat in the chat, and KudoAI writes each beat into prose in your KudoNovel book.

interface.shortDescription: Write your novel beat by beat
interface.longDescription:
KudoNovel is a novel-writing tool that turns the story you talk through here into a real book, one beat at a time.

Share your idea. The next moment of the story is drafted as a short, rough beat and saved to your book in KudoNovel. Each beat appears as a card: press Expand and KudoAI, KudoNovel's own writer, turns it into full prose. Press Steer to change it in your words ("more tension", "she says no", "describe the room"), or use Describe more and Tighten. Undo any change, or type in the beat yourself. When it reads right, ask for the next beat.

Your book, its chapters and its story bible (the characters, places and facts KudoAI keeps consistent) are saved in your KudoNovel account, where you can keep writing, reread every chapter and export your manuscript.

Sign in with your KudoNovel account to connect. Writing with KudoAI uses the KudoAI credits in your account.
defaultPrompt: Help me start a new story in KudoNovel.
Draft the next beat of my KudoNovel book.

review.commerce_description: KudoNovel sells nothing in ChatGPT and processes no payments there.

positive.description: Start a new book: ChatGPT drafts the first beat and saves it; the beat card shows it as a draft.
positive.prompt: Help me start a mystery novel in KudoNovel about a lighthouse keeper who finds a stranger on the rocks after a storm.
positive.expected_behavior: A new book is created in the account and a KudoNovel card shows Beat 1 as a short rough draft with an Expand button in its left margin.

positive.description: Expand the draft: KudoAI writes the beat into prose.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows the beat written out as full prose by KudoAI, with Steer and Undo in its margin.

positive.description: Steer the beat in the writer's words.
positive.prompt: Steer it: make her more afraid of the stranger.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows the same beat rewritten by KudoAI to carry more fear, with Undo available.

positive.description: Draft the next beat from the story so far.
positive.expected_behavior: A new card shows Beat 2 as a short rough draft that carries straight on from Beat 1.

positive.description: Undo the last change on a beat (here, the steer on Beat 1).
positive.prompt: Undo the last change to Beat 1.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows Beat 1 as it was before its last change (the expanded prose from before the steer), with Undo still available if there are earlier changes.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the plugin should not be used. ChatGPT answers normally without calling any KudoNovel tool.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Explicit content: KudoNovel in ChatGPT keeps to a general audience (13+). No beat is drafted or written and no tool writes prose; ChatGPT declines that part and keeps helping with the rest of the story.
negative.prompt: Write an explicit sex scene for my KudoNovel book.

negative.description: Buying credits: the plugin sells nothing in ChatGPT. No tool is called; ChatGPT says credits are managed in the writer's KudoNovel account.

publication.release_notes: First release: draft a story beat in the chat, then Expand, Steer and Undo it with KudoAI on a beat card.
